Welcome to Kalkstein Chiropractic—serving Towson, MD for 60+ years. We’re a state-of-the-art chiropractic and rehab clinic helping patients move better, recover faster, and stay pain-free.

Our team includes Dr. Warren Kalkstein, Dr. Angie Darcus, Dr. Brady Dailey, Dr. Nick Kuhl, our Nurse Practitioner Caroline Chell NP, licensed massage therapists, exercise specialists, and dedicated CAs.

We specialize in chiropractic care, sports injury rehab, ART, dry needling, massage therapy, corrective exercise, prenatal, and post-surgical care—focused on getting you out of pain and back to what you love.

📍 Towson, MD
